Matias's house is in a town. I live in Loreto. Loreto is a small town. The Country In the country there are woods, farms, and fields. Many people live on farms. People live in houses, too. There are no apartment buildings. Houses in the country are far apart. This is Jenna's house. I live on a farm in the country. Cities Cities are like very big towns. There are a lot of people, streets, and big buildings in cities. The buildings are close together. Many people live in apartments. This is Nada. Nada's apartment is in the city. I live in Cairo.
